## About

I am a PhD candidate in Economics at the University of Valencia (Department of
Economic Analysis), working in the **economics of education and human capital
development**. My research studies how teaching quality, pedagogical practices,
and education and social policies shape students' outcomes.

After completing my master's degree, I decided to gain experience in the private
sector, working at Deloitte, S.A. in Risk Advisory for financial markets, before
returning to academia to pursue my PhD.

[I gratefully acknowledge the financial support of the Conselleria d'Hisenda i Model Econòmic (HIECPU/2024/6) of the Generalitat Valenciana.]{.funding}
